update_message:
What's New in 2.1.13:

🧹 Major Codebase Cleanup
• Deleted 15+ unused legacy screen and widget files
• Removed old home_screen, album_detail_screen, artist_detail_screen
• Removed old now_playing_screen, modern_now_playing_screen
• Cleaned up deprecated widgets (mini_now_playing_bar, settings_sheet, etc.)
• Streamlined modern_ui.dart exports

📜 Lyrics Integration
• Added lyrics support to Now Playing screen
• Synced lyrics (.lrc) with timestamp highlighting
• Unsynced lyrics (.txt) fallback support
• Swipe up or tap lyrics button to view

🏷️ Quality Badge Improvements
• Quality badge now respects Settings toggle
• Badge shown in mini player title area
• Badge shown below progress bar in fullscreen
• Consistent styling across all screens

👆 Mini Player Enhancements
• All mini players now have prev/next swipe gestures
• Quality label wired to all mini players
• Fixed A-Z rail overlap with mini player padding
• SafeArea-aware padding for navigation bar

🔗 Navigation Fixes
• Fixed Go to Album navigation in Now Playing
• Fixed Go to Artist navigation in Now Playing
• Fixed keyboard shortcut for Now Playing screen

📋 Queue Management
• Queue reorder now actually moves tracks
• Drag-to-reorder properly updates playback queue

📤 Share Functionality
• Added share track option to Now Playing
• Added share track option to Album Detail
• Share via any installed app

⚙️ New Settings
• Added Floating Mini Player toggle in Player section
